focusedNodeTests.scope: synthetic aggregation and exact source/offset checks for 30 and 40 target runs

publicSnapshotTriage.scope: greedy exact text matches only; neither shared sense nor instructional quality verified

tests.fullRegression: not repeated for an authoring-tool-only change

realBrowser: not run; earlier automation rejected by saved permissions or management policy
limitations: word-form matches may reflect different senses, parts of speech or incidental mentions
inflections and semantic connections may not be detected
static task fields include independent assessment and annual-review days
the tool does not activate or create a learning course
personal learning, release compatibility, long-term storage and browser behavior are not established
candidate totals do not establish an IELTS score
